summary: I looked after the website day to day: planning work around clear goals, managing product uploads and content updates, and keeping pages accurate and SEO friendly. When bugs or issues showed up, I tracked them down and worked with developers and designers to fix them. I also helped new team members settle in and find their rhythm.

My first step into professional development. I built features for PHP web projects, worked with MySQL databases, and developed custom WordPress themes and plugins for client sites. Most of my front-end work was with HTML, CSS and JavaScript, and I also got to contribute to a React.js project.
